result.geometry_note: User-controlled fixed separation; not an optimized equilibrium geometry.
result.assumptions: Spin-aware HF/KS-DFT at fixed point nuclei. UHF/UKS can be spin contaminated and are not exact correlated solutions. Selected spin is an input state, not proof of a global ground state. Finite orbital/DFT grids require convergence checks. Orbital energies are not excitation energies. Source conformers and user-set separations are not geometry optimizations.

field.surface_note: Threshold is a fraction of sampled field peak, not enclosed probability. Density integrals on the display grid can under-resolve tight cores; exact basis-space counts are reported separately. Spin-density sign represents alpha-minus-beta density, not wavefunction phase.

_provenance.limitations: Fixed geometry, HF/STO-3G, preview 41³ isosurfaces at 0.08 of grid peak. No browser SCF/DFT or geometry optimization. Recorded process timing is generation-time, not browser performance.
